A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, with matching methods, sections, and Appendices A–D. Text, equations, tables, and figure images support comparison, including identification of relocated panels.

before.justification: Sections 4–6 and Appendices C–D report original token statistics, probe accuracies, feature-ablation results, and layerwise KL-divergence measurements.

after.justification: The original empirical analyses remain, with additional measurements for Llama-3.1-8B, including the results in Figures 10–12.

M1.justification: The evil-twins/GCG optimization, word-level model, token-removal scoring, sparse logistic probes, feature-zeroing interventions, and vocabulary-space projections remain unchanged. Newly disclosed probe-training details do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: The datasets and tasks remain unchanged: Tiny Stories, Alpaca, WikiText-103, OpenHermes-2.5, and Dolly-15k support the same prompt-optimization and analysis tasks. Adding an 8B model changes the model configuration rather than data or task coverage.

E2.justification: The natural-versus-natural and random-versus-natural probing controls and random-feature intervention baseline are retained. Matching panels across the main text and appendices reveals no added or removed comparison method.

E3.justification: V2 adds Llama-3.1-8B-base with 106 retained prompts in Table 2, increasing the open-model count from 17 to 18 and maximum model size from 3B to 8B. Existing models' sample counts, the 500-step optimization budget, and stopping/filtering thresholds remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Token-removal sensitivity, feature ablation, and layerwise representation analyses are extended to Llama-3.1-8B in Figures 1, 9, 11, and 12. This adds evidence about the existing analysis questions at a larger model size without introducing a new analysis framework.

E5.justification: Error bars and shaded uncertainty bands already appear in v1 and retain the same reporting practice in v2. No new seed information, repeated-run counts, uncertainty-estimation definitions, or significance tests are supplied.

E6.justification: V2 adds 8B-model token-composition, influence, probing, ablation, and KL-divergence results. Its new Figure 10 row shows probe-control accuracies often well above chance at larger feature counts. Existing entropy values and Table 1 scores are retained; several apparent plot replacements are relocations.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5) and their mathematical reasoning remain unchanged apart from punctuation. Neither version adds distinct theoretical results or proofs relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract and principal contributions retain the claims about influential tokens, corpus rarity, distinguishable representations, and prediction-building patterns. The added introductory GCG definition clarifies the study's already stated methodological scope.

C2.justification: Section 7 newly acknowledges that optimized prompts can be benign and that distinguishing benign from malicious prompts requires further investigation, qualifying the proposed jailbreak-detection application. The stated model-size limitation also changes from 3B to 8B.

D1.justification: V2 replaces the future code/model-release promise with a repository link. Appendix A.3 newly specifies scikit-learn logistic regression, 100 iterations, L2 penalty, the liblinear solver, and 1e-4 tolerance; Appendix A.2 adds the eight-A100 optimization hardware disclosure.

R1.justification: V2 adds Buitinck et al. (2013) to support the scikit-learn implementation disclosure. The substantive positioning relative to prompt optimization and interpretability research remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 adds a short introductory definition, the benign-prompt qualification, and Appendix A.3, while refining wording and cross-references and removing the acknowledgments. Most prose and the section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: Existing plots gain 8B series or panels, and Table 2 gains one row. Representative panels are redistributed between Figures 5–7 and Figures 10–12, with associated legend, spacing, and pagination changes. The overall display design is retained.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves reproducibility through the repository link and explicit probe-training and hardware details, and appropriately qualifies the security application by acknowledging benign optimized prompts. The 8B evaluation adds limited scale evidence, but its unusually high probe-control accuracies in Figure 10 remain unexplained despite Section 6.1's retained near-random-control description. These gains support a limited overall improvement.
